utility_environmental_service.label: Utility / environmental service
utility_environmental_service.value: Avista Utilities provides electric generation, transmission and distribution and natural gas distribution. Alaska Electric Light and Power provides electric service in Juneau.

regulated_competitive_operating_model.label: Regulated / competitive operating model
regulated_competitive_operating_model.value: Rate-regulated electric and natural gas utilities.

generation_fuel_technology_mix_electric_.label: Generation fuel / technology mix [electric generators]
generation_fuel_technology_mix_electric_.value: Avista Utilities generates power from hydroelectric, natural gas and biomass plants. Alaska Electric Light and Power relies primarily on hydroelectric generation.

connections_service_accounts.label: Connections / service accounts
connections_service_accounts.value: Electric service accounts outnumber natural gas service accounts. Alaska Electric Light and Power adds electric accounts in Juneau.

regulatory_jurisdiction.label: Regulatory jurisdiction
regulatory_jurisdiction.value: Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission, Idaho and Oregon public utility commissions, Regulatory Commission of Alaska, and Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.

gas_network_delivery_gas_utilities.label: Gas network / delivery [gas utilities]
gas_network_delivery_gas_utilities.value: Natural gas distribution mains and service lines in Washington, Idaho and Oregon.

notes: Approved rate base and several operating metrics are uncertain.
